arithmetic_notes: All counts are seeded for the scenario's Tuesday morning. Heart pills: 7 pills on hand at 1 each morning means the last pill is taken next Tuesday morning, so the bottle is empty a week from the scenario day. The pharmacy needs 7 days (refill_lead_days 7), so the refill must be ordered this Tuesday, a full week before the bottle runs out. That makes the brief line 'order by Tuesday' true. Wipes: 12 on hand at a seeded rate of 5 a day lasts 2.4 days from Tuesday morning, which lands partway through Thursday, so the forecast line 'wipes run out around Thursday' is true. Pads: 18 at 4 a day lasts 4.5 days, out on Saturday; with a 3 day lead the order-by day is Wednesday. Gauze: 1 on hand at 1 a day, so it is gone Wednesday at the latest; Lisa's Tuesday capture uses the last one and the count goes to none, which updates the shared record the same day.
